requirement_text.REQ-432:
Follow-on to REQ-373 (service_catalog version/status lifecycle + real PinResolver.Lookup, status: done on the backend) and to REQ-399 (case-detail dependency-version/provenance screen, status: done -- REQ-399 already built the GET /api/v1/instances/{id}/pins route, web/src/hooks/useInstancePins.ts, and web/src/components/instances/InstancePinsPanel.tsx, wired into InstanceDetailPage.tsx). Filed from ISS-0898, split from ISS-0890's WF05-FULL-20260929 PLATFORM UAT report: the platform-instance-pin-survives-catalog-change scenario (test/fixtures/uat/scenarios/platform/instance-pin-survives-catalog-change.yaml) is BLOCKED not because the read-only provenance screen is missing (REQ-399 built that) but because two operator ACTIONS the scenario's own steps exercise have no UI anywhere, and REQ-399's own SCOPE explicitly excluded one of them: "any UI affordance to CHANGE a pin from this screen... is a separate requirement if one is ever filed."
WHAT EXISTS TODAY, verified 2026-09-30 by direct source read: - `POST /api/v1/admin/services/:service_id/versions` (publish) and
  `POST /api/v1/admin/services/:service_id/retire` (retire) are real,
  shipped REQ-373 routes (lib/letflow/routers/admin_services.ex,
  design doc lib/letflow/design/req373-service-catalog-version-lifecycle.md
  §7), gated by the existing :AdminServicesManage permission. Grepping
  web/src/api/services.ts and web/src/pages/admin/services/ServicesPage.tsx
  for "publish"/"retire"/"version" returns zero hits beyond the existing
  `ServiceRecord` type -- neither route has any frontend client function or
  UI control. An operator today cannot publish a new service-connection
  version or retire an old one from the GUI at all, which is exactly the
  scenario's own step 2 action.
- `POST /instances/:id/rebind-pins` is a real, shipped REQ-078/PIN-05 route
  (lib/letflow/routers/instances.ex, `Letflow.Engine.PinRebind.rebind_pins/3`,
  200 response `{instance_id, changes, rebound_at}`, each change item
  carrying `ref`/`prior_version`/`new_version` per the
  `INSTANCE_PINS_REBOUND` event it appends). Grepping web/src for "rebind"
  returns zero hits beyond REQ-399's own read-only provenance panel and its
  test -- there is no rebind client function, no rebind action/button/dialog
  anywhere in web/src. An operator today cannot deliberately move a running
  case onto a different pinned version from the GUI at all, which is
  exactly the scenario's own step 5 action (with a caller-supplied reason
  -- `rebind_attrs()` requires `:idempotency_key`, per
  lib/letflow/routers/instances.ex's own design notes, and the scenario's
  step 5 input is `reason: \"External system retires the old endpoint at
  month end.\"`).
- Case history rendering: grepped web/src for any existing generic
  event-timeline renderer capable of showing an `INSTANCE_PINS_REBOUND`
  entry with actor/prior_version/new_version/reason (EO-005's own evidence
  requirement, "the case history shows the change with the operator's
  name, the previous and new version, and the reason given") -- confirm at
  implementation time whether InstanceDetailPage.tsx's existing
  history/timeline section already renders arbitrary event types generically
  (in which case this requirement only needs the rebind action itself to
  produce the right event, already true by construction since
  `rebind_pins/3` already appends the real event) or needs a
  dedicated case for this event type -- do not assume either way without
  checking.

THIS REQUIREMENT BUILDS: (1) a typed `publish`/`retire` client pair in web/src/api/services.ts and UI controls on web/src/pages/admin/services/ServicesPage.tsx (a "publish new version" action taking the publish_attrs() fields plus a version string, and a "retire" action) for a PLATFORM_ADMIN-equivalent operator; (2) a typed `rebind` client function (POST /instances/:id/rebind-pins) and a rebind action/dialog on REQ-399's InstancePinsPanel.tsx (or InstanceDetailPage.tsx) requiring the caller to supply a reason string, wired to the real endpoint; (3) confirm, and if needed extend, the case history/timeline rendering so an `INSTANCE_PINS_REBOUND` entry's actor, prior_version, new_version and reason are all visible per EO-005; (4) the named pipeline_test spec.
OUT OF SCOPE: any change to `Letflow.ServiceCatalog`, `PinResolver`, `PinRebind`, or any of REQ-373/REQ-399's already-shipped routes (pure frontend consumption/action wiring against already-shipped endpoints); re-scoping or modifying REQ-399's read-only provenance display beyond what is needed to add the rebind action to the same screen; PLC-01/module_ref catalog versioning (still the identical, already-named SCOPE GAP pin_resolver.ex's own moduledoc states, unscoped to any stage, restated by both REQ-373 and REQ-399).

task.description: WF-02 Step 2c (security gate, HARD GATE) for REQ-432. Verify branch feature/WF02-REQ432-20260930. Follow docs/agents/workflows/WF-02_requirement_implementation.md Step 2c, .claude/agents/security-reviewer.md and docs/agents/instructions/security-invariants.md in full. Read the real branch diff yourself (git diff main...HEAD -- web/ lib/ test/fixtures/; do not rely on step-02b-frontend-dev.json's summary). Do the scope test first against security-reviewer.md's list: this is a FRONTEND-ONLY diff (web/ + one scenario yaml + a design doc), but it adds client calls that send tenant-scoped mutations (POST rebind-pins with an Idempotency-Key header, POST publish/retire of admin service versions) and renders event payload/actor data (INSTANCE_PINS_REBOUND history row, actor-name join). Decide in/out of scope per the file's criteria and justify in one clause either way; if in scope, give a verdict APPLIES/NOT-APPLICABLE for EACH of INV-1..INV-8 by number and run the How-to-verify for every APPLIES one. Specifically also check: (a) no token/secret stored or logged, no new auth storage mechanism, no hardcoded API base URL or credential in the new Playwright spec (the spec uses resolveCredential/getKeycloakToken helpers -- confirm no literal password/secret committed); (b) tenant scoping: new query keys go through useTenantScopedQueryKeys (no cross-tenant cache bleed -- verify the new page-level timeline query and pins/instance invalidation are tenant-scoped); (c) UI gating is cosmetic only and the backend is authoritative -- confirm no client-side-only permission decision is relied on as a security control, and the role checks reuse existing idioms (CANCEL_ROLES, isPlatformAdmin); (d) XSS: PinsReboundSummary/EventHistoryPanel render payload.reason and version strings as React text (no dangerouslySetInnerHTML, no href built from payload data); (e) the e2e spec's cleanup/side effects cannot touch another tenant's data. FAIL immediately on any applicable invariant failing (all BLOCKER). Run only read-only / grep checks; run no servers. Lint your handoff: mix letflow.lint_handoffs --dir handoffs/WF02-REQ432-20260930/step-02c-security-reviewer.json. Commit your handoff by explicit filename and push to origin feature/WF02-REQ432-20260930. Claim by setting status IN_PROGRESS only; on finish set COMPLETED/FAILED, fill result, real-clock completed_at; never edit task/created_at/started_at; do not write registry.json. Run everything synchronously in the foreground.
acceptance_criteria: if in scope: verdict APPLIES/NOT-APPLICABLE for each of INV-1..INV-8 by number, with the verification evidence for each APPLIES
checks (a) through (e) each answered with file/line evidence
PASS or FAIL with every failed invariant enumerated

result.summary: SECURITY-REVIEWER PASS for REQ-432. Scope test: IN SCOPE (conservative) - frontend-only diff (web/, one scenario yaml, one design doc; no lib/ code, no migrations, no config) but it adds client mutations against tenant-scoped routes (rebind-pins, admin publish/retire) and renders tenant event payload/actor data, i.e. response-consuming/shaping of a tenant-scoped entity. INV-1 NOT-APPLICABLE: no Ecto schema/migration/table/query touched (git diff main...HEAD -- lib/ config/ priv/ lists only lib/letflow/design/req432-...md); tenant prefix derivation remains server-side. INV-2 NOT-APPLICABLE: no server response shape changed; client only hides controls cosmetically, backend routes are authoritative (see c). INV-3 NOT-APPLICABLE: no Lua/WASM host function. INV-4 APPLIES, PASS: no token/secret stored or logged in app code (grep localStorage/sessionStorage/console in new src files: 0 hits); Idempotency-Key is a random UUID (crypto.randomUUID, InstancePinsPanel.tsx newIdempotencyKey) not a secret; INV-4 heuristic grep for literal secrets over changed files: 0 hits; grep on config/ lib/ not needed (no change). INV-5 NOT-APPLICABLE: no new server lookup-by-ID handler; client uses existing routes, 404 surfaced as generic 'Case not found.' (InstancePinsPanel.tsx rebindErrorMessage) with no cross-tenant distinction. INV-6 satisfied by this handoff (each invariant assessed above). INV-7 NOT-APPLICABLE: no lib/ or migration change, no Repo.query. INV-8 NOT-APPLICABLE to Elixir (no lib/ change); frontend error paths are typed (err.status branches with default fallback). INV-9 NOT-APPLICABLE to this diff: publish form sends endpoint_url (ServicesPage.tsx) but client never makes the outbound request; server-side validation is backend scope, platform-admin-only route, REQ-373. Checks: (a) PASS - no token/secret persisted or logged; no new auth storage; instances.ts/services.ts use relative /api/v1 paths via shared client (postWithHeaders pre-existing, client.ts:262); e2e spec has no literal secrets: passwords come from resolveCredential('UAT_QA_ADMIN_PASSWORD','admin-pass') / worker equivalent (spec lines 102-103, 359-360); the 'admin-pass' fallback is the existing dev-realm convention used across web/tests/e2e (admin/services.e2e.spec.ts, categories, env04 etc.), API base is process.env.BPM_TEST_URL ?? 127.0.0.1:8080 (line 56), non-blocking note only. (b) PASS - useRebindPins.ts uses useTenantScopedQueryKeys().instances and invalidates instanceKeys.all(); InstanceDetailPage.tsx page-level timeline query goes through useInstanceTimeline which keys on useTenantScopedQueryKeys().instances.timeline(id,cursor,pageSize) (useInstances.ts:56-62); ServicesPage invalidates tenantKeys.admin.services(). (c) PASS - gating is cosmetic: rebind button gated by canCancel (CANCEL_ROLES, InstanceDetailPage.tsx:31,143,335) and ACTIVE status; publish/retire controls inside existing isPlatformAdmin block (ServicesPage.tsx:29,215); no client-side check is a security control, errors 403/404/409/422 from server are surfaced. No new role idiom invented. (d) PASS - PinsReboundSummary.tsx and EventHistoryPanel.tsx render payload.reason, refs, versions, actor as React text children; grep for dangerouslySetInnerHTML/innerHTML/href= across new/changed components and ServicesPage diff: 0 hits; payload fields are type-guarded as strings (str()). (e) PASS - e2e spec creates its own uniquely-named fixtures (pl_pin_<uuid8>), cleanup only cancels the three case ids it created via the admin session of its own tenant (spec lines 129-136); published service version intentionally left; no delete of tenant-wide data, no cross-tenant ids.
